economics_basis: Studio formula: net = price/1.18; contribution = net - landed - (0.02*price + 1.2) - 0.08*net; margin = contribution/net; fx 3.3; before CAC. price_ils = the slot's median price when the pack has one; when the median is empty (or mixes unit and pair) the price is the Nordic composition's or my suggestion, written in why_he, not approved (rule h.10). No pick loses money at the slot median price. Prints (PR1) are priced before local framing.
score_note: style_score is one japandi score per product (the same product gets the same score in every slot), master-designer 2026-10-12, provisional until a japandi Bible is approved. AliExpress items without a card are scored from the scale reviewer's look plus the Nordic room reviews; items nobody looked at were not picked.
